procedure BakeryFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy BakeryPolicy
  sheet CakeOrders "CakeOrders" { customer: Text, email: Email, pickup: Date, status: Text, price: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in CakeOrders

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the bakery! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch CakeOrders
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "confirmed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure ClinicFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new patient, then follow up once"
  policy ClinicPolicy
  sheet Visits "Visits" { patient: Text, phone: Phone, starts: DateTime, status: Text, copay: Money, diagnosis: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Visits

  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.patient default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure TutoringFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new student, then follow up once"
  policy TutoringPolicy
  sheet Students "Students" { student: Text, parent_email: Email, next_session: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, learning_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Students

  let first = draft email to r.parent_email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.student default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the center! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Students
  let now_r = find all where parent_email == r.parent_email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.parent_email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.student}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
  notify owner "Please update the office manager yourself."
}
